content: संपत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Prosperity, increase of wealth; संपत्तौ च विपत्तौ च महतामेकरूपता <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 Success, fulfilment, accomplishment; न च शोचत्यसंपत्तौ तद्विज्ञेयं तु राजसम् <ls>Ms. 12. 36</ls>. .²3 Perfection, excellence; as in रूपसंपत्ति. .²4 Exuberance, plenty, abundance. .²5 A suitable state or condition.
